NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: this house stored section data in per-file ad-hoc arrays (footing_types) instead of the elements[] that houses 01-09 use. Every original string is kept in a *_printed_as field. NOTE: the array named 'column_sections' actually held BEAM sections - every cut_ref names a B-mark - so those became element_type 'beam', with the cut label kept in section_ref. confidence_score is null because this house never recorded one; it was NOT invented.
